1518396.title: App Control Advanced --- Edit a category, sso enforcement disabled, set included user with local user/group
1518396.steps:
1. go to Firewall->App Control Advanced, enable app control on Firewall-> App Control Advanced 
2. edit a category like ‘DOWNLOAD-APP’, set included user/group with local user ‘YILI/qa1’, and excluded user/group ‘none’, set action to enable block, click OK to apply configuration 
3. enable app control on LAN zone 
4. make sure sso enforcement is disabled, make sure access rule from LAN->WAN is set to allow all 
5. from a lan client whose domain name is ‘YILI/qa1’ (included in group1), download p2p resource using Xunlei Thunder, verify that app control could trigger SSO authentication
6. from a lan client whose domain name is not ‘YILI/qa1’, download p2p resource using Xunlei Thunder, verify that app control will still trigger SSO authentication, but app control will not take effect for this pc 
7. repeat step 1-7, in step 2, edit a category like ‘DOWNLOAD-APP’, set included user/group with local group ‘group1’, and excluded user/group ‘none’, set action to enable block, click OK to apply configuration

1518397.title: App Control Advanced --- Edit a signature, sso enforcement enabled , set both included and excluded user/group
1518397.steps:
1. go to Firewall->App Control Advanced, enable app control on Firewall-> App Control Advanced
2. edit a Xunlei Thunder signature, set included user/group with local group ‘group1’, and excluded user/group ‘YILI/qa2’, set action to enable block, click OK to apply configuration
3. enable app control on LAN zone
4. make sure sso enforcement is enabled, make sure access rule from LAN->WAN is set to allow all
5. from a lan client whose domain name is ‘YILI/qa1’, download p2p resource using Xunlei Thunder, verify that app control triggers SSO authentication and takes effect
6. from a lan client included in ‘YILI/qa2’, verify SSO triggers but app control does NOT take effect
7. for other client, tbd

1518398.title: App Control Advanced --- Edit an application, sso enforcement enabled , set included user/group
1518398.steps:
1. go to Firewall->App Control Advanced, enable app control on Firewall-> App Control Advanced 
2. edit a Xunlei Thunder application, set included user/group with local user ‘YILI/qa1’, and excluded user/group ‘none’, set action to enable block, click OK to apply configuration 
3. enable app control on LAN zone 
4. make sure sso enforcement is enabled, make sure access rule from LAN->WAN is set to allow all 
5. from a lan client whose domain name is ‘YILI/qa1’, download p2p resource, verify SSO triggers & app control takes effect 
6. from a lan client not ‘YILI/qa1’, verify SSO triggers but app control does NOT take effect 
7. repeat step 1-6 using group ‘group1’ instead of local user

1518399.title: App Control Advanced --- Edit an application, sso enforcement enabled , set excluded user/group
1518399.steps:
1. enable app control 
2. edit Xunlei Thunder app, set excluded user/group ‘YILI/qa1’, included ‘all’ 
3. enable app control on LAN 
4. ensure sso enforcement is enabled 
5. from user ‘YILI/qa1’, SSO triggers but app control does NOT apply 
6. from others, SSO triggers & app control applies 
7. repeat using group ‘group1’

1518400.title: App Rules --- add an app rule policy, sso enforcement disabled , set included user/group
1518400.steps:
1. create match object with DOWNLOAD-APP 
2. create rule including ‘YILI/qa1’ 
3. enable app rules
4. ensure sso enforcement disabled 
5. from ‘YILI/qa1’ SSO triggers & app control applies 
6. from others SSO triggers but app control does NOT apply 
7. repeat with group ‘group1’

5. for ‘YILI/qa1’: SSO triggers but app control does not apply
6. others: SSO triggers & app control applies
7. repeat using group

1518410.title: Edit a signature, then enable app control, verify that sso enforcement will be enabled automatically
1518410.steps:
1. edit signature & add included user -> SSO enforcement remains disabled
2. enable app control globally -> still disabled
3. enable app control on LAN zone -> SSO enforcement automatically becomes enabled
